devin-translation:settings.webhookGuideI: Every event is an HTTPS POST with a JSON body and Standard Webhooks signature headers, sent to the URL you register. One handler receives everything and branches on event_type — it only needs to do three things:
devin-translation:settings.webhookGuideS: When you add an endpoint (or change its URL, re-enable it, or click Verify) we immediately POST an endpoint.verification event whose data.nonce you must echo back: respond 2xx with that exact nonce in the body, e.g. {"nonce": "…"}. This is the only event that needs an echo — every other event just needs a 2xx. Until it passes, the endpoint stays pending and receives no events.

Each request carries webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature headers. Compute HMAC-SHA256 over {webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{raw body} with your signing secret (base64-decode the part after whsec_) and compare it with the space-separated v1,… values in the signature header — any match is valid, and there are several while a secret rotation is in progress.

Return a 2xx within 10 seconds; anything else is retried with backoff for about three days, after which the endpoint is disabled. Retries and replays reuse the same webhook-id, so treat a repeated ID as already handled.

Use it to verify every request you receive: compute HMAC-SHA256 over {webhook-id}.{webhook-timestamp}.{raw body} with the base64-decoded key after whsec_, and compare the result with the v1,… values in the webhook-signature header. See "How to receive webhooks" on this page for a full example.
